# UFO Dossier

UFO Dossier is a searchable archive of publicly released U.S. government records of unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP), from the PURSUE releases at https://www.war.gov/UFO/. PURSUE is the Pentagon program that published these files.

It is not a claim that those records prove extraterrestrial origin.

## Counts

The public counts are different things. Do not treat them as the same number:

- official files
- checked passages (quotes verified against the original file)
- sightings (one sighting can be described in more than one passage)
- PURSUE releases

A series is a group of separate sightings, not one sighting.

## Preferred pages

- https://www.ufodossier.com/
- https://www.ufodossier.com/releases
- https://www.ufodossier.com/sources
- https://www.ufodossier.com/audio
- https://www.ufodossier.com/about
- https://www.ufodossier.com/ask

Ask the Archive answers only from records in this archive and cites case IDs inline.
